mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we are seeing overcast skies near Verona Area High School. Under the full moon, temperatures will drop to an overnight low of 54 degrees with no rain in the forecast. Please note the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The finance department has released the 2027 proposed budget and 2026 adopted budget, while the Plan Commission is set to meet November 4th to review development projects including Ardent Glen and new business park site plans.

There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market happening today, alongside live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga on Sunday, October 26th or catch trivia at multiple locations next week.
The Verona Police Department reported an incident from Thursday, October 15th, involving the arrest of a school bus driver for O W I, though no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor is the classic Turtle. The store is currently open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
